get_group_info: query a yuanbao group to get its name, owner, and member count by group code
query_group_members: list all members, find a user by name, or list bots in a yuanbao group
search_sticker: search the built-in yuanbao sticker catalog by keyword and return matching sticker candidates
send_sticker: send a built-in yuanbao sticker to the current chat or a specified chat by name or id
send_dm: send a private direct message with optional media files to a user in a yuanbao group
